html:
SMTO-CFG-0083 — SMTO's request to add Skills wasn't in a form it accepts

GUID: 15c2af83-a6ae-5209-86cf-201994452cd8
Slug: capability-activation-invalid-request
Domain: CFG · Subsystem: capability_activation

What happened

  • SMTO's Agent tried to add Skills to this Task in a way SMTO doesn't allow, such as asking for more than eight at once or mixing them with other lookups. Nothing was turned on or run.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Watch the Task for a Capability request blocked note. If the Task keeps working afterwards, you don't need to do anything. SMTO tells the Agent to ask for eight Skills or fewer in a separate step, and it usually does.
  2. If the Task stops, open Capabilities by the message box and set the Skills the work needs to Always. Skills set to Always are included from the start, so the Agent doesn't have to add them mid-Task.
  3. Check which steps the stopped Task already finished, then send a new request for the rest. Capability changes apply to the next request, and checking first avoids repeating finished work.

What success looks like

  • The Task uses the Skills it needs without another Capability request blocked note.

If it still fails

  • Send Copy error details to the person who manages SMTO. Don't loosen Permissions or other safety settings to get past this; they are separate from this message.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Dynamic Skill activation rejected discover_tools because skill_ids was not 1 to 8 well-formed exact Skill IDs, carried extra arguments, combined section_ids or capability_ids with not-yet-active Skills, or no current capability selection existed.

What this means

  • Dynamic activation requires a nonempty list of at most eight well-formed exact Skill IDs and an existing selection; activating new Skills cannot be mixed with tool/section discovery in the same request. The owning policy, configuration or publication transaction validates this state. Diagnostics do not grant authority, replace accepted snapshots, execute capabilities or publish a site; preserve the exact current decision and evidence.

Why this can happen

  • Dynamic activation requires a nonempty list of at most eight well-formed exact Skill IDs and an existing selection; activating new Skills cannot be mixed with tool/section discovery in the same request.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect skill_ids and whether section_ids/capability_ids try to discover content before those Skills are active.

How to fix it

  • Send skill_ids on its own (at most eight exact Skill IDs, each a lowercase letter followed by up to 127 lowercase letters, digits or underscores) and request section_ids or capability_ids only after those Skills are active (request and _request_in in src/agent_runtime/native/capability_activation.py). Confirm the run has a current_capability_selection under Automatic Capability Selection.
  • Request up to eight exact Skill IDs from the capability manifest. Split Skill activation from tool or section discovery.

Retry and execution caution

  • The reported capability or interaction condition changes.

How to verify the fix

  • A valid bounded activation completes before separate tool/section discovery.

What not to do

  • Do not bypass frozen authority, operation permissions or credential requirements.

Technical notes

  • The owning policy, configuration or publication transaction validates this state. Diagnostics do not grant authority, replace accepted snapshots, execute capabilities or publish a site; preserve the exact current decision and evidence.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
